response.query: What realistic pilot budget line items and per-institution time/FTE allocations (data integration, engineering, model dev, governance/compliance, workshops) should be proposed for Moroccan banks?
response.answer: Moroccan banks should budget for data governance, engineering, and integration; model development; and compliance/workshops, with 1-2 FTEs per institution annually.

results.title: Axiom Allocations for Colleges & Universities | Syntellis
results.content: Expand Search: the search bar will appear on the bottom of the header for you to search the content of the site. # Axiom Allocations for Higher Education. ## Centralize Allocation Data to Manage Complexity. Axiom™ Allocations empowers institutions to develop allocations of revenue and expenses to support the annual budget process. This solution is critical for universities that analyze margins at a school/program level or run a responsibility centered management (RCM) budget model. The data associated with budget allocations is stored in Axiom’s centralized database, so it is available for reporting and analysis and can easily be rolled over from one year to the next. Axiom Allocations enables institutions to:. * Manage complex allocation rules and associated metrics (e.g., FTE, square footage, student credit hours, major, minor, etc.). * Provide a cost allocation mechanism for indirect expenses. * Increase data transparency for allocation rules across the institution. * Automatically incorporate allocation calculations into departmental budgeting processes. - Driver Based Planning and Forecasting.

results.title: Axiom Allocations | Strata Decision Technology
results.content: # Axiom Allocations. Centralize Allocation Data to Manage Complexity. Strata’s Axiom™ Allocations solution empowers higher  education leaders to develop allocations of revenue and expenses to support the annual budget process. These capabilities are critical for universities that analyze margins at a school/program level or run a responsibility centered management (RCM) budget model. The data associated with budget allocations are stored in Axiom’s centralized database for efficient reporting and analysis, and can be easily rolled over from year to year. Once allocations are calculated, the data directly integrate into the departmental budgeting process, reducing effort and speeding the budget process. ### **Manage complex allocation rules and associated metrics (e.g., FTE, square footage, student credit hours, major, minor, etc.)**. ### **Increase data transparency for allocation rules across the institution**. ### **Automatically incorporate allocation calculations into departmental budgeting processes**. ## Manage Complex Resource Allocation Methods. Axiom Allocations supports both metrics-based and incremental-based allocations. ### Metrics-Based Allocations. Resources are distributed based on trend data for any number of metrics including, but not limited to, enrollment, credit hours, FTE, research funding, and square footage. This method allows resource allocation to flex based on shifts in university metrics. ### Incremental-Based Allocations. Start with a base, either last year’s budget or actuals, make central driver-based assumptions for growth, and pair that with department-driven budget requests for additional funding to support strategic initiatives. Axiom Allocations improves transparency, data integrity, and financial accountability across the institution. With a range of reports that track allocation rules, colleges and universities can increase trust and gain buy-in for the RCM model:. * **Metric Reports** – View RCM metrics for Responsibility Centers. * **Allocation Reports** – Easily create, manage, and view results of allocation model. * **Shadow Income Statements** – Provide units with a comparison view of the RCM allocation model versus previous budget model. ## An Allocations Solution Built on Industry Best Practices. Inspired by years working in university finance roles, we have designed our software to deliver strategy-based performance solutions that help you think boldly and surpass your goals.
